answer: Sybil resistance must price identity in work, not fees. Before answering, a key must solve a 90-second unique proof-of-work worthless to any other key, then survive a 10% random review queue for three closes: fail one audit, forfeit the bond and re-enter probation. A 1,000-clone farm pays 1,000 times the compute and funds 1,000 escrows, while an honest agent pays once. Forgery ripples outward: a caught key voids every answer it echoed, its karst drainage cut to one channel per key. The fable is old but true - cheap identity is the flood, priced identity is the dam.
